title: A provisional yard plan
notice: Fictional classroom model. Coordinates, dimensions and statements are supplied for learning only. They are not a survey, a construction drawing, local advice or a plan for a real household.

coordinateSystem.axis: x increases right; y increases down; the top edge is model north by classroom convention only

sourceCards.title: Household brief
sourceCards.text: The household wants vegetables, an unobstructed home-to-gate route and manageable care. The person carrying water participates in the decision.

sourceCards.title: Teaching frame
sourceCards.text: A 20 m by 12 m classroom frame includes an existing 8 m by 6 m growing area. It is model geometry, not a boundary or land-rights record.

sourceCards.title: Water and shade observation
sourceCards.text: A water point is beside the home. Water reportedly crosses the eastern yard in heavy rain; its extent and levels are unmeasured. One visit noted eastern-yard shade; it is not a seasonal shade study.

sourceCards.title: Later care statement
sourceCards.text: The person expected to manage a proposed compost area has not agreed to that extra work.

sourceCards.title: Concept A
sourceCards.text: Keep the existing growing area and investigate whether its care can improve while the route remains clear.

sourceCards.title: Concept B
sourceCards.text: Investigate a relocated growing area of the same model footprint, while retaining the original area until a decision is made.

sourceCards.title: Model area check
sourceCards.text: Both growing-area proposals occupy 48 m² in the supplied model: 8 × 6 and 6 × 8.

sourceCards.title: What remains unknown
sourceCards.text: Water quantity, quality and reliability; soil suitability; tenure; drainage levels; usable access; materials, costs, permissions and long-term care agreement remain unknown.

concepts.title: Concept A — care the existing growing area
criteria: Keeps the known existing growing area
Needs evidence about water, soil, drainage and care before change
conditions: Do not treat reported water movement as a drainage design

concepts.title: Concept B — investigate a different location
criteria: Uses the same 48 m² model footprint
Leaves the original growing area as existing evidence
Needs extra location and route checks before choice
conditions: Check whether the proposed outline obstructs real movement
Check water, soil, shade and reported water path
Do not count both growing areas as active production

decision.provisional: Investigate Concept A first; defer physical changes while evidence and household agreement are incomplete.
decision.rejected: Concept B is not rejected as impossible. It remains a conditional alternative, not a proven improvement.
decision.deferral: Deferral is a valid decision while the prerequisites are unresolved.

dependencies.before: Household agreement, route observation, water and soil checks, relevant permissions
dependencies.cost: Unknown; obtain comparable quotes only after a defined proposal
dependencies.care: Agree who will do the ongoing work before assigning it

dependencies.before: Agreement from the person expected to manage it and a practical care plan

revision.change: Defer the proposed compost area. Keep the growing-area investigation and route evidence unchanged.
revision.reason: No person has agreed to the added care work.
revision.nextOwner: Household and facilitator to record an agreed care arrangement or leave the component deferred.

facilitator.question: Which source supports the 48 m² comparison?
facilitator.answer: W-MAP supplies both footprints and W-CHECK records the calculation. A picture alone is not the source.

facilitator.question: Does the report about water crossing the eastern yard establish levels or an earthworks design?
facilitator.answer: No. It is W-OBS, a reported statement with unmeasured extent and levels.

facilitator.question: What must change after W-CARE?
facilitator.answer: The compost proposal, its phase/cost status and its care record all change to deferred. The earlier version and reason remain visible.
